description: You will find one of the most charming squares in the city in the western part of the old town. On the square there is the Cathedral and a statue of Bishop Anton Martin Slomšek, and next to them there is a park with a swimming pool and a statue of Korlek. Market name: The oldest name of the square after the parish church of St. John the Baptist, is Kirchenplatz. In 1859, the square was renamed Stolni trg, because that year the Slovenian bishop Anton Martin Slomšek transferred the seat of the Lavatine diocese from Št. Andraž in Carinthia to Maribor. In 1919, the square was renamed Slomšek Square.
